items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: He said, you better bring your six piece back... He said, you better bring the little band like this. Now, he hired me

ctx.x: Most of all my job work like that. That's like private parties.

That's right, that's right. Now, we got, you know, I got me coming, about two Saturdays from now, I'm going over to Lake at the concert club over there. Oh, yeah. They had St. Louis concert club, I used to go over there before. Well, I'm in Manhattan, what he's paying is a good price and all. Well, like I told him, man, he had asked me, could I have more pieces? I told him, he's all right with me. He wanted, I used to go over there with six, he wanted to bring eight. So the last time I went over there, he said,…
